title: Harbor managed policy
description: Enterprise policy for the Harbor extension. Chrome's managed-storage schema format requires exactly one type per node and has no union types, so a Harbor policy document — whose rules mix strings, arrays and objects — can't be declared here field by field. Instead, set `policy` to that document serialized as a JSON string, the same one Firefox's policies.json "3rdparty" key takes as an object. See docs/PERMISSIONS.md ("The policy file") for the document's shape and examples.

policy.title: Policy document (JSON string)
policy.description: A Harbor policy document, encoded as a JSON string. Loaded at the highest precedence; cannot be overridden by the user's own policy or by per-origin grants. Example: {"version":2,"deny":["Egress(third_party)"]}
